summary_1line: Angada rebukes the fleeing monkey army, urging them to reclaim courage against Kumbhakarna, briefly rallying them though the titan continues devastating their ranks.

image_candidates.scene_text: The gigantic Kumbhakarna leaps over the city wall and roars, towering like a mountain while the monkey army scatters in terror.
Prince Angada stands defiantly before the fleeing monkeys, raising his arm and shouting for them to return to battle.
Monkeys hurl trees and mountain rocks at Kumbhakarna, the missiles shattering harmlessly against his colossal body.
